title: ボーノなレースに必要なもの！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Taiki Shuttle has become stronger, faster, and even beefier in her quest to defeat Hishi Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her rival in such good form inspires Hishi Akebono to whip up high protein meals to help her get stronger, faster, and bulkier herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thus, Hishi Akebono and I work as one to build her form to an even greater plateau.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She makes her own war declaration in response to Taiki Shuttle's challenge at a press conference leading up to the Mile Ch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The world takes notice as the two archrivals gear up for an epic showdown, boosting expectations for the Mile Ch. off the charts!
